title: Saddle Finance — StableSwap Price Imbalance Arbitrage Analysis
root_cause: A virtual price calculation bug in the legacy Saddle pool allowed profit to be extracted simply by repeatedly swapping sUSD back and forth between Curve and Saddle
other_code:
Attacker
    │
    ├─[1] Euler flashLoan(15,000,000 USDC)
    │
    ├─[2] [Inside onFlashLoan callback]
    │       │
    │       ├─ Curve: USDC(1) → sUSD(3)
    │       │       15M USDC → ~15M sUSD
    │       │
    │       ├─ Saddle: sUSD(0) → SaddleUSDV2(1)
    │       │       ~15M sUSD → SaddleUSDV2 (Saddle bug: inflated output)
    │       │
    │       ├─ Saddle: SaddleUSDV2(1) → sUSD(0)
    │       │       SaddleUSDV2 → sUSD (reverse swap)
    │       │
    │       ├─ Curve: sUSD(3) → USDC(1)
    │       │       sUSD → USDC
    │       │
    │       └─ A small USDC surplus generated each cycle
    │           Accumulated profit by repeating multiple times
    │
    ├─[3] Repay Euler flash loan
    │
    └─[4] Loss: ~$11,000,000
